concept: Tracing a problem back to its root cause instead of just treating the symptom
source_inspiration: original content, informed by da Vinci's investigative-observation tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student encounters a recurring problem (a group project keeps failing, a habit keeps breaking) with an obvious surface symptom and a less obvious root cause
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to address the symptom or dig for the root cause
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what digging deeper revealed that treating the symptom wouldn't have

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a plausible root cause distinct from the surface symptom
